committee: RESCIND AND REPLACE Notice of Presentation for Resolution No. 190-38 (COR) - Speaker Frank F. Blas, Jr.
location: Guam Congress Building, Public Hearing Room
title: Buenas yan Hafa Adai! Join me in presenting Resolution No. 190-38 (COR), “Relative to commemorating the Two Hundred Fiftieth (250 th ) Anniversary of the United States of America; recognizing the historic contributions, sacrifices, and loyalty of the people of Guam to the United States since 1898; honoring the service of generations of Guam residents in the Armed Forces of the United States; and reaffirming the enduring friendship, shared values, and unwavering support of the people of Guam as a part of the American family.” The presentation will be held on Wednesday, July 1, 2026 , at 12:30…
